design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY with Modern Culinary Editorial Polish (inspired by NYT Cooking, Mob Kitchen, and Bon Appétit)
emotional_tone: Warm, inviting, gastronomic, artisanal, disciplined yet approachable, rich culinary storytelling with crisp utility

entry_surfaces./: editorial food hero with curated culinary story, quick search, interactive recipe showcase, category ribbons and floating AI chef button
entry_surfaces./recipes: filter sidebar left with cuisine/diet/time, responsive culinary grid right with sort controls and active tag pills
entry_surfaces./recipe/:id: immersive recipe detail with cover hero, serving scaler widget, interactive checklist ingredients, cooking steps, review list and ratings summary
entry_surfaces./recipe/new: structured recipe studio with dynamic multi-row ingredient builder, nutrition facts, cover preview, and step-by-step editor
entry_surfaces./dashboard: culinary workspace with tabs (My Creations, Saved Bookmarks, Cooking History, Drafts), user stats, and quick create action
entry_surfaces./shopping-list: interactive grocery checklist split by aisle/recipe, quick-add item bar, clear completed, and export modal
entry_surfaces./profile/:username: chef/foodie profile card with follow button, bio, culinary stats, published recipes grid, and follower counts
entry_surfaces./ai-assistant: floating responsive sous-chef modal with pantry generator ('potatoes, onions, eggs'), substitute advisor, and recipe creator
entry_surfaces./admin: moderation dashboard with tabbed user management, recipe audits, category tags editor, comment moderation, and platform analytics
entry_surfaces./login: split culinary auth — artisanal food illustration panel left with community quote, credential form with remember me right
entry_surfaces./register: split culinary signup — membership benefits & recipe perks left, registration form right

grids_and_layouts.navbar: sticky top-0 z-40 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF7F2]/90 border-b border-[#E7E2D9]
grids_and_layouts.recipe_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6
grids_and_layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous warm whitespace (p-6, p-8, py-16, py-24). Avoid cramped boxes. Clean 1px warm borders (#E7E2D9) with subtle ambient shadows.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle warm paper grain overlay (2% opacity) on #FAF7F2 body for tactile culinary book feel
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped badges with soft warm backgrounds (e.g., bg-orange-100 text-orange-800, bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800, bg-stone-100 text-stone-800)
visual_enhancers.recipe_card_hover: Subtle card elevation translateY(-3px) with soft ambient drop-shadow shadow-[0_12px_24px_rgba(28,25,23,0.06)] and image zoom (scale-105 transition-transform duration-500)
visual_enhancers.serving_scaler: Tactile plus/minus counter pill with instant quantity recalculation animation
visual_enhancers.floating_ai_badge: Subtle glowing pulse ring (ring-2 ring-orange-500/30) with warm chef hat icon

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in with subtle 8px upward slide using motion/react or Tailwind animations
motion_and_interactions.interactive_elements: transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease
motion_and_interactions.stagger_grid: Stagger children by 0.05s on initial feed load
motion_and_interactions.accordion_steps: Smooth expand/collapse for step tips and substitutions
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Sonner toast with warm theme icons for Saved, Rated, Shopping List added, and Copied Share Link

accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens exceed APCA standards and WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against their declared surface backgrounds
accessibility.interactive_affordances: Visible focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-orange-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on all inputs, buttons, and links
accessibility.aria_labels: Clear aria-labels on icon-only buttons (bookmark, like, share, scale, close AI assistant, remove grocery item)
accessibility.screen_reader_announcements: Live region for ingredient quantity recalculation when scaling servings

hero_featured.description: Artisanal hand-spun pasta in rich slow-simmered tomato sauce with fresh basil

hero_secondary_culinary.description: Linguine aglio e olio with fresh herbs and toasted garlic in rustic ceramic bowl

category_chef_special.description: Executive chef seasoning gourmet culinary entree

category_masterclass.description: Professional chef precision knife work and prep in warm commercial kitchen

fresh_ingredients_rustic.description: Crisp farm-fresh produce with purple onions, fresh lemons, cucumber and olive oil

baking_dessert_spread.description: Artisan baking station with fresh butter, organic eggs, flour and wild berries

testing_attributes.convention: kebab-case data-testid on every interactive and key informational element

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the warm editorial food platform aesthetic (warm paper #FAF7F2, deep stone #1C1917, vibrant terracotta #EA580C accent). Never build a generic college CRUD app.
Implement the responsive website with full desktop navigation (Explore, Categories, Trending, Shopping List, Dashboard, Floating AI Assistant, Profile/Auth) and smooth mobile collapse.
Ensure all ingredient quantities support automatic recalculation with serving scaling (e.g. 2 to 8 servings) and one-click add to persistent Shopping List.
Build the floating AI Sous-Chef chat assistant with real culinary context, pantry recipe generation ('potatoes, onions, eggs'), and instant ingredient substitutions.
Include full data-testid attributes on all buttons, forms, cards, inputs, and modals as outlined in the testing attributes section.
Use Toast notifications via Sonner for bookmarking, saving, copying recipe links, and shopping list operations.
